messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected - 502s and closed streams on /v1/paging/stream from 14:32 UTC, error rate ~3.8% over 5m. See: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/3965001111 :rotating_light:
alejandra (eng-runtime): I see the first failed canary at 14:28 for sdk-client v3.4.0 rollout. Paging cursor decode exceptions in logs: \n  `Err: invalid cursor encoding at decode_cursor.go:72`\n
samir (oncall): Ack - I'm taking. Pinging deploy-bot for rollout details.
deploy-bot: rollout event: sdk-client v3.4.0 -> canary (10%), started by @alejandra at 14:25 UTC. Canary hosts: us-west-2-a.
alejandra (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally with the new client: when client sends cursor with `base64url` variant, server expects standard base64 -> decode fails and we return 502 on stream init. This affects streaming pagination handshake.
nora (eng-ml): Does this only affect streaming/paging endpoints or embeddings too?
alejandra (eng-runtime): Only /v1/paging/stream and /v1/paging/list so far. Embeddings unaffected.
samir (oncall): Impact assessment: slice shows 3.8% global error rate, concentrated on canary host pool and some legacy clients hitting new gateway. Customer-facing: some customers on Dedicated hitting retries. No billing spikes.
jamie (product): Any premium customers impacted? Which organizations? We need to communicate if any SLAs breached.
samir (oncall): Early list: org-zetta (low-volume), org-magma (production jobs) - contacting CS now.
eve (sre): Recommended immediate mitigations: 1) flip feature flag `ff-sdk-paging-v3` to off for canary, 2) rollback sdk-client rollout to v3.3.x, 3) temporary compatibility shim in gateway. Which is fastest?
alejandra (eng-runtime): Flip flag first - fastest. `ffctl set ff-sdk-paging-v3 false --scope canary`
samir (oncall): Doing the flag flip now. `ffctl set ff-sdk-paging-v3 false --scope canary --who samir`
incident-bot: ACTION: feature flag ff-sdk-paging-v3 set to false for canary at 14:40 UTC by samir.
samir (oncall): Monitoring error rate... updating dashboard.
[~90s later]
samir (oncall): Error rate dropped to 0.9% on canary hosts, overall 1.1%. Some traffic still hitting upgraded gateways in other regions.
alejandra (eng-runtime): I'll queue an emergency rollback for the sdk-client rollout. `redwood deploy rollback --artifact sdk-client:v3.4.0 --to v3.3.7`
deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 14:44 UTC, target: revert canary rollout.
eve (sre): Recommend notifying customers with ongoing jobs: CS ping sent to org-magma and org-zetta.
jamie (product): Thanks - please include suggested mitigation steps for customers (retries with exponential backoff, pin SDK to 3.3.x).
nora (eng-ml): We'll add a temporary guidance note in docs: "If you see stream init 5xx, pin to 3.3.x or set Accept-Cursor-Variant header to standard base64".
samir (oncall): Handing off to eve for longer-term mitigation/monitoring. Samir -> Eve oncall shift at 15:00 UTC.
eve (sre): Taking over. Current status: ff off, rollback in progress, error rate trending down to baseline (~0.2%). I'll keep watch for any rollback failures.
alejandra (eng-runtime): Root cause sketch: client bump changed cursor encoding to base64url for compactness; server decode path not backwards compatible. Fix options: broaden decode to accept both variants, add robust cursor sniffing, add regression tests for cursor roundtrip.
jamie (product): Postmortem owner? Need comms draft for affected customers.\alejandra (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem write-up. Plan to ship server fix and test in next patch release (v3.4.1) before re-rollout.
eve (sre): Ongoing: verify rollback completion, confirm all canary traffic back to v3.3.x, maintain incident bridge for 2h for follow-ups.
samir (oncall): CS confirmed org-magma saw ~12 failed job runs, they accepted retry plan. No SLA breaches reported yet.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated - canary rollback + flag kill confirmed at 14:47 UTC. Status: post-incident review required.
alejandra (eng-runtime): Quick fix PR opened: `runtime: accept base64url cursor variants` - CI running.
nora (eng-ml): Add an eval to the regression suite for cursor roundtrips across encodings.
jamie (product): I'll draft a short customer note summarizing what happened and next steps.
eve (sre): Closing notes: keep this thread for timeline only. We'll create a postmortem doc and link it here when ready. :white_check_mark:
